summary: Context-only committee read: the dashboard moved to MIXED with a new, low-confidence US Q3 stagflation label and a rising growth-scare caution score. The caution state is not a measured drawdown edge: its 21-session pullback rate is 16.0% versus a 17.8% base rate. Credit/funding remain healthy, volatility is normalizing, breadth above the 200-day average is about 65%, and systematic flows are aligned-adding. Treat the regime as fragile and internally mixed, not as authority for a position. Factor intelligence is immature: only nine panel dates, no survivors in the scorecard, composite non-tradeable, and factor-attention authority remains unearned. No hypothesis was staked because the available evidence does not justify spending the limited weekly budget.

The thesis ledger also contains many overdue open items, limiting reliable comparison with current contradictions.
